description:
Save a formation on the fund's bench.

    Args:
        fund_id: Your fund.
        name: Formation name, e.g. "Iran Oil Shock".
        roster: [{"bot_id": "dir_long_btc", "weight_pct": 60}, ...]. Weights
            under 100 total leave the rest in cash. Empty list = all cash.
            Shares may not add up to more than 100.
        emoji: Optional emoji.
        description: When you'd play it.
        leverage: 1-20x for this formation (applied to new positions).
        sizing: "weights" = size by your weights (default),
                "router" = the router's Kelly sizing (skips bots without history).
        template_key: Start from a template instead (see list_formation_templates).
        from_current: Snapshot the live roster + settings instead.
        rationale: REQUIRED — why this config exists. Published on the fund's
            public manager's log.
name: create_formation
